title: Pre-tool clarification of the consumer predicted-depth source
problem: The parent spec correctly forbids Position from Python/Node consumer decisions and assigns Position to analyzer/auditor control, but its projective-depth prose does not name the allowed consumer-side source of predicted previous depth. Leaving that value implicit would permit incompatible implementations or accidental Position leakage.

requirements: Commit and push this correction before any H2 tool byte is created.
Every H2 tool, preflight record, formal result and receipt must bind both the parent spec SHA-256 and this correction SHA-256.
No hypothesis, fixture, raster, formula, tolerance, witness threshold, process count, attack minimum or verdict mapping changes.

resolvedSemantics.consumerCurrentPoint: For integer output cell (x,y), unproject the top-left raster pixel center through the current camera using decoded current Depth as positive camera-space -Z. This uses only x, y, current Depth and frozen camera parameters.
resolvedSemantics.consumerPreviousPoint: Transform that reconstructed current world point into current owner-local coordinates using the owner selected only by exact current Material Index; apply the same owner's frozen previous rigid transform.
resolvedSemantics.consumerPredictedPreviousDepth: Project consumerPreviousPoint through the frozen previous camera and use its positive camera-space -Z.
resolvedSemantics.consumerDepthGate: The Python and Node consumers compare direct-Z and reciprocal-depth samples independently to consumerPredictedPreviousDepth using the unchanged max(1,predictedDepth)/1024 tolerance.
resolvedSemantics.positionControlPrediction: The analyzer independently uses decoded current Position as the current world point, applies the same Material-selected rigid transform and previous camera projection, and computes the authoritative control predictedPreviousDepth plus expected Vector.
resolvedSemantics.formalMeasurementSet: A projective-depth-rescued measurement cell must be rescued by the consumer calculation and must independently pass the Position-derived reciprocal-depth gate. The analyzer reports both sets and their intersection; the frozen minimum 1024 applies to the intersection.
resolvedSemantics.agreementGate: Every consumer inverse-depth-valid or rescued cell counted toward a verdict must also pass the Position-derived inverse-depth gate. Consumer-only cells are reported and excluded; they do not automatically reject unless their inclusion changes a decision array or another hard gate fails.
resolvedSemantics.positionIsolation: Position remains unavailable to both consumers. Adapter control arrays and analyzer inputs may not be passed as a consumer input directory.

unchanged: decoded repeat identity and metadata allowlist
toolBoundary: All H2 tools must require --spec and --correction arguments and reject either identity mismatch. The correction is not optional and cannot be inferred from file location.
scientificEffect: This is an executable semantic clarification made before tool creation and before measurement. It does not use an observed outcome and cannot improve a future H2 verdict after the fact.
